methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch on 2026-06-14. FreshBooks official page showed a 90% promotional discount active at time of fetch; the regular (pre-promo) monthly prices ($23/$43/$70) are used as the canonical figures, with the promotional prices noted. Wave annual pricing discrepancy: official page showed $190/yr while SoftwareAdvice showed $170/yr — official page used as primary. Harvest pricing shows month-to-month as the primary price with annual rates noted. QuickBooks Online pricing sourced from SoftwareAdvice (official quickbooks.intuit.com/pricing repeatedly timed out); marked as fallback. Bonsai prices are per user per month. Zoho Invoice is free with no paid tiers as of this date. Invoice Ninja annual discount calculated from published figures ($14/mo x12=$168 vs $140/yr = ~16.7% discount). All telephony fields set to null (non-telephony vertical).

vendors.name: FreshBooks
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.freshbooks.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. A 90% promotional discount (for 3 months) was active at time of fetch; the 'was' prices shown on the page ($23/$43/$70) are used as the regular monthly rates. Corroborated via SoftwareAdvice profile (showed $21/$38/$65, slightly different — possibly an earlier price point). Official page figures used as primary.

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: Up to 5 billable clients. Promotional price active at time of fetch was $2.30/mo for first 3 months (90% off). Regular monthly rate $23/mo used here. Annual pricing not published on page.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Up to 50 billable clients. Most popular tier. Promotional price at time of fetch was $4.30/mo for first 3 months. Regular monthly rate $43/mo used here.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Unlimited billable clients. Promotional price at time of fetch was $7.00/mo for first 3 months. Regular monthly rate $70/mo used here.

plans.name: Select
plans.notes: Enterprise tier. 'Talk to a Consultant' — no public self-serve price.

limits: Premium and Select: unlimited billable clients
keyFeatures: Automated invoicing with online payment acceptance
bestFor: Freelancers
Self-employed professionals
Small service businesses
Consultants and creatives billing by project or hourly
enrichment.provenance: Features and trial length from freshbooks.com/features and freshbooks.com/pricing (fetched 2026-06-15). Compliance: freshbooks.com/security returned 404; freshbooks.com/data-security returned 404; no compliance page accessible — all compliance fields set to null. 30-day free trial confirmed on pricing page.

vendors.name: Wave
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.waveapps.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Direct fetch of https://www.wave.com/en/pricing/ returned 404; waveapps.com was the correct domain. SoftwareAdvice corroboration confirmed $0 Starter and $19/mo Pro but showed annual at $170/yr vs official page $190/yr — official figures used. Wave Advisors is a managed bookkeeping add-on service, not a self-serve software tier.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Free forever. Unlimited estimates, invoices, bills, and bookkeeping records. Online payments available at standard transaction fees (2.9% + $0.60 per card).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Month-to-month $19/mo. Annual plan $190/yr (~$15.83/mo). Annual discount not explicitly stated as a percentage on the page. Includes discounted payment processing (2.9% + $0 for first 10 transactions/month), auto bank import via Plaid, automated late payment reminders.

plans.name: Wave Advisors
plans.notes: Managed bookkeeping service add-on starting at $199/mo. Includes a dedicated bookkeeper, monthly financial statements, and expert support. Not a software-only tier — bundles human services.

limits: Starter: no automatic bank import, no branded invoices (no custom logo), no automated payment reminders
Pro: bank sync requires Plaid (not all institutions supported)
Live support only with paid plans or add-ons
keyFeatures: Branded invoices with logo and custom colors (Pro)
Online payment acceptance (credit/debit cards and bank payments)
Multiple user accounts with permission controls (Pro)
bestFor: Freelancers and very small businesses needing free core invoicing
Sole proprietors wanting full accounting without a monthly fee
US/Canada-based small businesses
enrichment.provenance: Features from waveapps.com/pricing (fetched 2026-06-15). Security page waveapps.com/legal/security-and-privacy confirms PCI-DSS Level 1 certification; no SOC2, HIPAA, or GDPR statements found on that page — those fields set to null. Free forever Starter tier confirmed. waveapps.com/security and waveapps.com/features both returned 404.

vendors.name: Zoho Invoice
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.zoho.com/invoice/pricing.html fetched 2026-06-14 (two separate fetches confirmed). Zoho Invoice is positioned as entirely free with no paid tiers; growing businesses are directed to Zoho Billing. Usage limits apply on the free plan.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever. Up to 2 users, 3 projects, 500 invoices/year. 'Powered by Zoho Invoice' branding required. No paid tiers — Zoho Billing is the upgrade path for larger businesses.

limits: Free plan: max 500 invoices per year
Free plan: 'Powered by Zoho Invoice' branding on documents
No paid tiers — Zoho Billing is the upgrade path
keyFeatures: Client self-service portal (view credits, approve quotes, pay invoices)
Quotes and estimates with one-click conversion to invoices
Time tracking and billable expense logging
Reporting (AR aging, top customers, revenue by item)
bestFor: Freelancers and small businesses needing free professional invoicing
Businesses already using the Zoho ecosystem (CRM, Books, Expense)
Teams requiring a client portal at no cost
enrichment.provenance: Features from zoho.com/invoice/ (fetched 2026-06-15). Compliance from zoho.com/compliance.html (fetched 2026-06-15): SOC 2 Type 2 explicitly stated as covering 'All cloud services and on-premise products of Zoho' (includes Zoho Invoice) — soc2 true; GDPR compliance stated org-wide with DPA available — gdpr true. HIPAA: Zoho holds a SOC 2 + HIPAA Type 2 certification, but it applies only to an enumerated product list (Zoho CRM, Desk, Expense, Checkout, Creator, Analytics, Mail, Sheet, WorkDrive, Sign, etc.) — Zoho Invoice is NOT among the HIPAA-covered products, and the zoho.com/invoice/ product page makes no HIPAA/BAA claim. hipaa corrected from true to null (product-scope over-claim: certification belongs to sibling products, not Zoho Invoice). Limits from zoho.com/invoice/pricing.html.

vendors.name: Invoice Ninja
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://invoiceninja.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14 (two separate fetches). Annual discount calculated: Pro $14/mo x 12 = $168/yr vs $140/yr billed = 16.7% (~17%). Enterprise base $18/mo x 12 = $216/yr vs $180/yr = same ~17% discount. Enterprise pricing tiers by user count (1-2 through 51-100 users); $18/mo is the 1-2 user base rate.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Self-hosted open-source option. Cloud free tier also available with basic invoicing.

plans.name: Ninja Pro
plans.notes: Month-to-month $14/mo. Annual plan $140/yr (~$11.67/mo, promoted as '10 months + 2 months free'). Single user. annualDiscountPct ~16.7%, rounded to 17.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Base price $18/mo (month-to-month) for 1-2 users. Annual $180/yr for 1-2 users. Price scales with user count tiers (1-2, 3-5, 6-10, 11-20, 21-50, 51-100 users). Includes bank sync (Yodlee, GoCardless), multiple companies, custom URL.

plans.name: Premium Business+
plans.notes: Starting from $280 — pricing varies; treated as quote-only given the custom nature above the user-count tiers.

limits: Free tier: single company only (Pro: up to 10 companies)
Custom fields: up to 4 per section
Tax rates: up to 3 per invoice
Self-hosted option requires own server infrastructure
keyFeatures: Kanban project management with billable time tracking
Custom domain and white-label client portal (Enterprise)
Vendor purchase orders and inventory tracking
bestFor: Freelancers and small businesses wanting free unlimited cloud invoicing
Teams requiring open-source self-hosted invoicing for data sovereignty
Businesses needing multi-language/multi-currency billing
Agencies managing multiple companies under one account
enrichment.provenance: Features from invoiceninja.com/features/ (fetched 2026-06-15). Privacy policy at invoiceninja.com/privacy-policy/ explicitly references GDPR and discloses third-party vendors per GDPR requirements — gdpr set to true. PCI compliance link present in policy. SOC2 and HIPAA not mentioned anywhere on accessible pages — set to null. Free cloud tier and self-hosted open-source option both confirmed as genuinely $0 — freeTier true.

vendors.name: Harvest
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.getharvest.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14 (two separate fetches confirmed month-to-month vs annual rates). Harvest is primarily a time-tracking and invoicing tool. The Teams and Enterprise plan names were confirmed across both fetches.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 seat, 2 projects only. Includes time tracking, invoicing, expense tracking, Mac and iOS apps. Permanently limited (not a trial).

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: Month-to-month $11/seat/mo. Annual rate $9/seat/mo ($108/seat/yr). Annual discount ~18%. Unlimited projects and clients. 50+ core integrations.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Month-to-month $17.50/seat/mo. Annual rate $14/seat/mo ($168/seat/yr). Annual discount ~20%. Includes advanced features beyond Teams tier.

limits: SOC2 not held directly — vendor relies on Google Cloud's SOC2 certification
keyFeatures: Time tracking via browser, desktop, and mobile apps
Automated invoice generation from tracked time and expenses
Team capacity and utilization reporting (Harvest Forecast)
Online payment acceptance via Stripe and PayPal
QuickBooks Online and Xero accounting sync
Activity log and entry change history
bestFor: Service firms billing clients by tracked hours
Agencies managing project budgets and team capacity
Remote teams needing timesheet approvals before invoicing
enrichment.provenance: Features from getharvest.com/features (fetched 2026-06-15). Security page getharvest.com/security states PCI-DSS merchant certificate held; SOC2 is indirect via Google Cloud hosting (vendor's own words: 'We rely on our server host's audit') — direct SOC2 not claimed, set to null. No HIPAA mention found. GDPR: privacy policy at getharvest.com/privacy-policy explicitly cites Article 6 GDPR legal bases, references a Data Processing Agreement, and covers EU Standard Contractual Clauses for international transfers — gdpr set to true. Data controller is Bending Spoons S.p.A. (Italian company, acquired Harvest). Free tier confirmed: 1 seat / 2 projects permanently free. 30-day free trial also available for paid plans.

vendors.name: Bonsai
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.hellobonsai.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14 (two separate fetches confirmed monthly vs annual pricing). All prices are per user per month. Elite plan requires a minimum of 3 users.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Month-to-month $15/user/mo. Annual rate $9/user/mo. 40% annual discount.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Month-to-month $25/user/mo. Annual rate $19/user/mo. ~24% annual discount.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Month-to-month $39/user/mo. Annual rate $29/user/mo. ~26% annual discount.

plans.name: Elite
plans.notes: Month-to-month $59/user/mo. Annual rate $49/user/mo. ~17% annual discount. Minimum 3 users. Includes dedicated onboarding for teams of 10+.

limits: Basic plan: no invoicing or contracts (time tracking + CRM only)
Essentials: scheduling limited to 1 event type
bestFor: Independent freelancers needing contracts, proposals, and invoicing in one tool
Creative professionals (designers, developers, writers) billing project-based
Small agencies requiring client-facing portals and project insights
enrichment.provenance: Features and limits from hellobonsai.com/pricing (fetched 2026-06-15) and hellobonsai.com/a/freelance-invoice-software (fetched 2026-06-15). Compliance: trust.hellobonsai.com returned 403; hellobonsai.com/security returned 404; hellobonsai.com/privacy contains no SOC2, HIPAA, or explicit GDPR certification statements (only references EU legal bases and a linked Trust & Security Center that was inaccessible) — all compliance fields set to null. No free forever plan exists; 7-day trial only confirmed from pricing page — freeTier false. English-only limitation stated on features page.

vendors.name: QuickBooks Online
vendors.provenance: Official quickbooks.intuit.com/pricing timed out on multiple fetch attempts (2026-06-14). Prices sourced from SoftwareAdvice (https://www.softwareadvice.com/accounting/quickbooks-online-profile/) as fallback — marked accordingly. SoftwareAdvice showed Simple Start $38/mo, Essentials $75/mo, Plus $115/mo, Advanced $275/mo. Note: SoftwareAdvice also referenced a promotional Simple Start at $17.50/mo for 3 months, regularly $35/mo — suggesting their $38 figure may itself be slightly stale. These figures are used as the best available approximation; a fresh direct fetch from quickbooks.intuit.com is recommended for the highest precision.

plans.name: Simple Start
plans.notes: 1 user. Basic income/expense tracking, invoicing, receipt capture. Source is SoftwareAdvice fallback (official page timed out). Promotional rates exist ($17.50/mo for 3 months per SoftwareAdvice, suggesting regular may be ~$35/mo — discrepancy noted; $38 used as listed on fallback source).

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Up to 3 users. Adds bill management, time tracking. Source is SoftwareAdvice fallback (official page timed out).

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Up to 5 users. Adds inventory tracking, project profitability. Source is SoftwareAdvice fallback (official page timed out).

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Up to 25 users. Adds custom reporting, dedicated account manager, batch invoicing. Source is SoftwareAdvice fallback (official page timed out).

limits: Inventory tracking: Plus and above only
Project profitability reporting: Plus and above only
keyFeatures: Full double-entry accounting (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow)
Automated bill management and accounts payable
Bank and credit card feed reconciliation
bestFor: Small to mid-size businesses needing full-spectrum accounting not just invoicing
US-based businesses wanting deep payroll and tax integration
Companies requiring inventory management alongside invoicing
enrichment.provenance: Features from quickbooks.intuit.com/accounting/ (timed out on 2026-06-15 fetch attempt) and SoftwareAdvice profile. Security/compliance: security.intuit.com returned only a bare app shell with no content; intuit.com/security redirected to security.intuit.com (same result); intuit.com/privacy returned 429 rate-limit. No SOC2, HIPAA, or GDPR compliance statements could be confirmed from any accessible Intuit/QuickBooks page — all compliance fields set to null. QuickBooks is a general accounting product not marketed for healthcare, making HIPAA particularly unlikely. 30-day free trial confirmed via SoftwareAdvice. No free forever plan exists.
